title: Dragon's Maze/Event deck
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Return to Ravnica block event decks)

paragraphs.text: Dragon's Maze has one tricolored Selesnya -centric event deck . It is mostly white / green with a splash of black for Lingering Souls .

The rares in this deck are Godless Shrine , Grove of the Guardian , Champion of Lambholt , Geist-Honored Monk , Odric, Master Tactician , Wayfaring Temple , Advent of the Wurm , Parallel Lives , and Growing Ranks . and Increasing Devotion .
